title: Rotting Oranges: Every Rotten Orange Spreads at Once
summary: Start the queue with every rotten orange; each minute is one level of the search.

takeaway.summary: Put every source in the queue at level 0. Process the queue one level at a time; each level is one minute. Track how many fresh oranges remain.
whenToUse: Spreading from several starting points at the same time
Distance from the nearest of many sources

scenes.narration: In a crate of oranges, every minute each rotten orange rots the fresh ones directly beside it. How many minutes until no fresh orange is left?
scenes.caption: Rot spreads each minute: how long until nothing's fresh?

scenes.narration: Re-checking the whole crate every minute would look at oranges that never change, again and again.
scenes.caption: Re-checking the whole crate every minute is wasteful

scenes.narration: Instead, put every rotten orange in the queue at once, as minute zero. They spread at the same time, so they start together. Five fresh oranges are left.
scenes.caption: Both rotten oranges start in the queue together

scenes.narration: Minute one. The top-left orange rots the oranges below it and to its right. They join the back of the queue, behind a divider: they spread next minute.
scenes.caption: Minute 1: the top-left orange rots two neighbors

scenes.narration: Still minute one: the bottom-right orange rots the one to its left. The empty space above it can't rot.
scenes.caption: Same minute: the bottom-right orange rots its neighbor

scenes.narration: Minute two takes the oranges rotted in minute one. The first rots the middle orange.
scenes.caption: Minute 2: the oranges rotted in minute 1 spread

scenes.narration: The next one rots the top-right orange, the last fresh one. The count reaches zero.
scenes.caption: The top-right orange rots: none fresh left

scenes.narration: Minute two finishes with nothing fresh, so the answer is two minutes.
scenes.caption: Every orange is rotten after 2 minutes

scenes.narration: That's multi-source breadth-first search: every source starts in the queue, and each level is one minute. If fresh oranges remained when the queue emptied, the answer would be minus one.
scenes.caption: Many starting points, one queue: multi-source BFS
